title: Object lifting of an adic system through the explicit pushforward tower
statement: Let X be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], T_n, i_n, j_n, hi_n and ai_n be as in [lem-weil-pbc-thickening-system-pushforward-functor], and J an ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Assume j_n is a closed immersion with kernel J^(n+1). For every H in CoherentFormalModule X J [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], there exists a coherent thickening system M [def-weil-pbc-coherent-thickening-system] and an isomorphism of inverse systems P(M)≅H.obj, where P is the explicit functor. No Full, Faithful, equivalence structure or evaluation comparisons are asserted.

proof.text: Closed sources are Noetherian. Annihilation of H_n by J^(n+1)=j_n.ker permits choosing a coherent preimage M_n and a term isomorphism through closed-immersion coherent equivalence; the affine range formula identifies the power conventions.

Conjugate the adjacent H transition by these term isomorphisms. Rewrite its target using pushforward composition and hi. Fully faithful j_(n+1),* uniquely lifts the conjugated morphism to M_(n+1)→i_(n,*)M_n; apply ai_n.homEquiv.symm to obtain the pullback comparison.

i_n is closed and its kernel is (J^(n+1)).comap j_(n+1), by the closed composite kernel formula. Apply the unit quotient for ai_n, transported from the chosen adjunction, and the closed pushforward ideal-power quotient comparison. The pushed pullback comparison becomes the induced adic quotient map of H, conjugated by isomorphisms; it is therefore invertible. Full faithfulness reflects isomorphisms, giving the required comparison isomorphism upstairs. This assembles the M_n into a coherent thickening system.

The term isomorphisms commute with adjacent transitions by construction. NatTrans.ofOpSequence extends hom and inverse to all transitions; their inverse identities are componentwise. The result is P(M)≅H.obj.
